auditTitle: Kingdom of Christ Ministries (KCM Church) - Comprehensive Security Audit
auditStep: Step 2: Complete Security Audit + Safe Fixes

critical.title: Authentication Bypass and Account Takeover in /api/auth/sync
critical.remediation: Enforced mandatory cryptographic token verification (Firebase ID token or Google credential). Unauthenticated requests without a verified token are rejected with 401 Unauthorized immediately.

high.title: IDOR & Unauthenticated Sensitive Member Data Exposure in GET /api/member/prayers
high.remediation: Enforced requireAuth check. For MEMBER role, queries are strictly constrained to user's authenticated UID (auth.uid). Only ADMIN and PASTOR roles can access corporate or cross-user prayer requests.

high.title: Information Disclosure on Donation Tax Receipts (/api/receipts/[id]/pdf & /api/receipts/[id])
high.remediation: Restricted receipt access to verified donors (matching user ID), authorized staff roles (ADMIN, PASTOR, BRANCH_MANAGER), or requests possessing the matching verification code (?verify=CODE).

high.title: Static Fallback Session Secret in Edge Session Token Verifier
high.remediation: Configured session verifier to disallow fallback static secrets in production mode. Explicit environment secret configuration is now strictly required.

high.title: Next.js Framework & Transitive Dependency Advisories (npm audit)
high.remediation: Automated npm audit reported 36 advisories including Next.js 14.2.0. Upgrading Next.js to 16.3.5 is a breaking architectural change requiring dedicated staging validation and migration testing.

medium.title: Raw SVG File Upload Allowed in /api/upload/service-icon (Stored XSS Risk)
medium.remediation: Disallowed SVG uploads and integrated validateFileSecurity with binary magic number verification for JPEG, PNG, and WebP.

medium.title: Missing In-Route Role Guard on POST /api/pastor/church-settings
medium.remediation: Added requireStaffOrDev guard in route handler ensuring defense-in-depth even if edge routing is bypassed.

medium.title: Timing Attack Vulnerability and Default Secrets in Backend Webhooks
medium.remediation: Implemented crypto.timingSafeEqual with buffer length matching and disallowed default secret fallbacks in production.

low.title: Missing Explicit Least-Privilege Permissions in GitHub Actions CI

fixesApplied: Patched /api/auth/sync to enforce cryptographic Firebase ID token or Google credential validation.
Updated AuthProvider.tsx and GoogleSignInButton.tsx to pass authentic ID tokens on sync calls.
Eliminated static key fallbacks in production for session.ts and edgeSession.ts.
Fixed IDOR in GET /api/member/prayers: authenticated members are strictly constrained to their own requests.
Protected /api/receipts/[id]/pdf and /api/receipts/[id] with donor ownership, staff role, or verification code checks.
Hardened /api/upload/service-icon: eliminated SVG upload and integrated binary magic bytes signature validation.
Added requireStaffOrDev to POST /api/pastor/church-settings for defense-in-depth.
Implemented crypto.timingSafeEqual and eliminated default webhook secrets in backend companion.
Created automated security test suite in frontend/tests/security/comprehensive-security.spec.ts.
remainingRisks: Next.js framework version 14.2.0 has upstream GitHub Security Advisories; scheduled migration to latest LTS recommended in a dedicated maintenance window.
Database connection string currently connects directly without PgBouncer connection pooler in DATABASE_URL.
Optional Cloudinary cloud name environment variable is unconfigured in local fallback environment.
